item.title: 0.1.0-beta.1
item.description:
## Wijeti 0.1.0-beta.1
First public beta. **Ad-hoc signed, not notarized** — read [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) for the one-time steps to open it safely. Download the build for your Mac: `arm64` for Apple Silicon, `x86_64` for Intel. Requires macOS 15 or later.
### Highlights - Redesigned Widget Library: grid or list, foldable categories, live preview, multi-select with bulk show/hide, placement, category and remove. - Add your own widgets (.zip, folder, .jsx/.js/.coffee, .html), then name and categorize them. - Permissions that cover what widgets actually need (Automation per app, Calendars, Camera, Bluetooth, Full Disk, …) with live status and one-click prompts. - New onboarding, Settings (General / Widgets / Permissions / Advanced) and a menu bar with a health indicator. - Automatic updates (Sparkle) with signed downloads.
### Fixes - Desktop widgets now come back after the widget server restarts. - Safer zip import; crash-looping server backs off and gives up instead of spinning. - Corrupt settings are moved aside instead of overwritten.
### Known limitations - Not notarized (see INSTALL.md); permissions may be re-requested after each update. - No default reload interval setting (widgets set their own refresh rate). - Intel build is tested under Rosetta only.
